This document 
outlines 
the checklist 
I1 for pressure, temperature, level, and flow transmitters, which must be carried out on 
an annually bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the above title block.

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Esmail Fouad, eng. Khalil Ahmad 3awad, the 
internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim Salman with MPIS office at EEHC, the 
document field tested at 30 Nov. 2002, revised by quality control eng. Abdel 
Menem AlEmam at EDEPCo., accepted by general director; eng. Mohamed El Sayed 
Abdel Ghafar, and approved by eng Awad Mohamed Fathy Head Sector of El-Aresh 
Power Station

items:
A work permit 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.

Close manual 
 valve for Transmitter line.
Safety helmet, shoes,
Digital Ammeter,
Pressure tester.

Adjustable 
 open end Spanner.
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.

Obtain copy of setting values for transmitter and 
 record it in the attachment MRDS.
Remove transmitter indicator and connect the ammeter leads.

Open high vent 
 to atmosphere and connect the pressure tester to high vent of transmitter.
Record the ammeter reading for 0 psi.

Inject the suitable pressure bar using pressure 
 tester, reference to setting values and MRDS and record the reading.
Vent out the pressure and record the ammeter reading.

Compare the ammeter reading with setting values, 
 if there is any error repeat steps until reach the required reading.

Return transmitter to service by removing the ammeter leads from the indicator 
 terminal and connect the indicator.
Remove the pressure tester.
Open the manual valve for transmitter line.
Vent out air from transmitter lins.
Close high vent.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.

 Stations
Technical Procedure

Transmitters
Introduction
This document 
outlines 
the checklist 
I1 for pressure, temperature, level, and flow transmitters, which must be carried out on 
an annually bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the above title block.
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Esmail Fouad, eng. Khalil Ahmad 3awad, the 
internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim Salman with MPIS office at EEHC, the 
document field tested at 30 Nov. 2002, revised by quality control eng. Abdel 
Menem AlEmam at EDEPCo., accepted by general director; eng. Mohamed El Sayed 
Abdel Ghafar, and approved by eng Awad Mohamed Fathy Head Sector of El-Aresh

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Close manual 
 valve for Transmitter line.
Tools and Equipments
Safety helmet, shoes,
Digital Ammeter,
Pressure tester.
Adjustable 
 open end Spanner.
Work to be carried out
Steps to Prepare for test
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Obtain copy of setting values for transmitter and 
 record it in the attachment MRDS.
Remove transmitter indicator and connect the ammeter leads.
Open high vent 
 to atmosphere and connect the pressure tester to high vent of transmitter.
Testing 
Procedure
Record the ammeter reading for 0 psi.
Inject the suitable pressure bar using pressure 
 tester, reference to setting values and MRDS and record the reading.
Vent out the pressure and record the ammeter reading.
Compare the ammeter reading with setting values, 
 if there is any error repeat steps until reach the required reading.
Return transmitter to 
service
Return transmitter to service by removing the ammeter leads from the indicator 
 terminal and connect the indicator.
Remove the pressure tester.
Open the manual valve for transmitter line.
Vent out air from transmitter lins.
Close high vent.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.
